description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Haste] and [Instant Cast 1], grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Raijin], [Apex Raijin Special Damage Tracker] and [Apex Raijin Special Level] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Raijin
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Raijin Special (0~2), removed after using Apex Raijin Special two times

description.name: Apex Raijin Special Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Raijin Special level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Raijin]

description.name: Apex Raijin Special Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Raijin Special level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Raijin]
